identification: Six old Australian timber transport boxes plus a stack of Holden hubcaps. Boxes seen: (1) Vacuum Oil Company Pty Ltd 'Plume Motor Spirit' box with the red Plume logo on the end; (2) 'Laurel Kerosene' box (Vacuum Oil Co) with the laurel wreath end; (3) 'British Imperial Oil Co Ltd, Shell Benzine, Highly Inflammable' box; (4) 'Old Court Whisky' box (Australian distillery brand); (5) 'Yalumba' wine box (green/red stencil); (6) a partly hidden box with 'WE...' stencilled. These are the pine crates that held two 4-gallon tins, 1910s-1950s. Hubcaps: at least two to four full chrome Holden hubcaps with black centre and the Holden lion, matching HK/HT/HG Kingswood/Premier type (late 1960s to early 1970s); exact count not visible. Cloud scan correct.
